sequences.name: Open a part file and assign a machine definition
sequences.description: Start Mastercam, select the default metric configuration file, open the part file 'single_contour.mcam', and choose a wire EDM machine definition.

steps.text: Start Mastercam, select the default metric configuration file, open the part file 'single_contour.mcam', and choose a wire EDM machine definition

sequences.name: Create a contour toolpath with a single contour
sequences.description: On the Wireframe tab, choose Point Position and identify the thread point on the gear shape. Create a point at X-40, Y0.2, Z0.

steps.text: Create a point at X-40, Y0.2, Z0

sequences.name: Enter wire path parameters
sequences.description: Set Wire Diameter to 0.2, Compensation Type to Computer, and Taper settings for Rapid height, UV trimplane, and UV height.

steps.text: Set Wire Diameter to 0.2, Compensation Type to Computer, and Taper settings for Rapid height, UV trimplane, and UV height

sequences.name: Backplot the toolpath to check for errors
sequences.description: Click Backplot selected operations, display wire and guides during backplot, run the backplot, and exit.

steps.text: Click Backplot selected operations, display wire and guides during backplot, run the backplot, and exit

sequences.name: Change toolpath parameters for better machining
sequences.description: Modify parameters and update the operation to include new settings for more effective machining.

steps.text: Modify parameters and update the operation to include new settings for more effective machining

sequences.name: Add Additional Skim Cuts
sequences.description: Enter 3 for additional skim cuts before tab to improve finish.

steps.text: Enter 3 for additional skim cuts before tab to improve finish

sequences.name: Select Glue Stop for Output
sequences.description: Choose a glue stop to pause machine before tab cut.

steps.text: Choose a glue stop to pause machine before tab cut

sequences.name: Set Lead-in and Lead-out Motion
sequences.description: Use arc motion with radius 0.125 and sweep 60 for entry and exit moves.

steps.text: Use arc motion with radius 0.125 and sweep 60 for entry and exit moves

sequences.name: Postprocess Toolpath to NC Code
sequences.description: Use postprocessor to convert Mastercam file to G-code.

steps.text: Use postprocessor to convert Mastercam file to G-code

sequences.name: Select Multiple Contours for Wire EDM
sequences.description: Use window chaining to select multiple contours.

steps.text: Use window chaining to select multiple contours

sequences.name: Add Glue Stops for Multiple Contours
sequences.description: Select 'Foreach tab' to add glue stops before each tab cut.

steps.text: Select 'Foreach tab' to add glue stops before each tab cut

sequences.name: Set Lead-in and Lead-out Motion for Multiple Contours
sequences.description: Use arc motion with radius 0.5 and sweep 90 for entry and exit moves.

steps.text: Use arc motion with radius 0.5 and sweep 90 for entry and exit moves

sequences.name: Verify selected operations in Toolpaths Manager
sequences.description: Click 'Verify' at the top of the Toolpaths Manager to display stock, wire, and guides in the Mastercam Simulator window.

steps.text: Click 'Verify' at the top of the Toolpaths Manager to display stock, wire, and guides in the Mastercam Simulator window

sequences.name: Rotate view in Simulator window
sequences.description: Right-click in the Simulator window and choose 'Isometric' then 'Fit' to get a better view of the toolpath and wire.

steps.text: Right-click in the Simulator window and choose 'Isometric'

sequences.name: Play through verification in Simulator window
sequences.description: Click 'Play' at the bottom of the Simulator window to move through the verification process.

steps.text: Click 'Play' at the bottom of the Simulator window to move through the verification process

sequences.name: Remove chips and observe slug dropout
sequences.description: Click 'Remove Chips' on the Verify tab, then click on the middle part to see the slug dropout of the stock.

steps.text: Click 'Remove Chips' on the Verify tab,
click on the middle part to see the slug dropout of the stock

sequences.name: Select thread points for NoCore toolpaths
sequences.description: On the Wireframe tab, choose 'Point Position' and select 'Thread Point'. Move cursor to end of a slot to detect center of an arc.

steps.text: Move cursor to end of a slot to detect center of an arc

sequences.name: Define thread points for NoCore toolpaths
sequences.description: Select four points as thread points, placing them close together to reduce travel time between slots.

steps.text: Select four points as thread points, placing them close together to reduce travel time between slots

sequences.name: Set up NoCore toolpaths parameters
sequences.description: Select 'Rapid', 'UVtrimplane', and 'UVheight' to 40.0 for the NoCore toolpath.

steps.text: Select 'Rapid', 'UVtrimplane', and 'UVheight' to 40.0 for the NoCore toolpath

sequences.name: Enable finish pass for NoCore toolpaths
sequences.description: Select 'Finish' and enable it to activate the default finish pass parameters.

steps.text: Select 'Finish' and enable it to activate the default finish pass parameters

sequences.name: Set compensation type for finish pass
sequences.description: Select 'Compensation Type' to compute for the finish pass.

steps.text: Select 'Compensation Type' to compute for the finish pass

sequences.name: Set start pass option for finish pass
sequences.description: Select 'Startpass at closest entity' to make the toolpath motion more efficient.

steps.text: Select 'Startpass at closest entity' to make the toolpath motion more efficient

sequences.name: Backplot NoCore toolpaths
sequences.description: Click 'Backplot' and select 'Quick verify' to display a shaded path the width of the wire as backplot progresses.

steps.text: Click 'Backplot' and select 'Quick verify' to display a shaded path the width of the wire as backplot progresses

sequences.name: Add a Makino machine definition for 4-axis toolpaths
sequences.description: Select 'GENERIC MAKINO 4X WIREMM (Tech).MCAM-WMD' from the machine definition list and click Add.

steps.text: Select 'GENERIC MAKINO 4X WIREMM (Tech).MCAM-WMD' from the machine definition list and click Add

sequences.name: Select geometry for 4-axis toolpaths
sequences.description: Change geometry in two planes: XY plane (lower contour) and UV plane (upper contour).

steps.text: Change geometry in two planes: XY plane (lower contour) and UV plane (upper contour)

sequences.name: Chain geometry for 4-axis toolpaths
sequences.description: Select thread point to the left of the part as the first toolpath chain and chain the upper contour starting at the green point.

steps.text: Select thread point to the left of the part as the first toolpath chain and chain the upper contour starting at the green point

sequences.name: Select synchronization method for 4-axis toolpaths
sequences.description: Select 'By Entity' from the Sync mode drop-down list to match endpoints of each entity.

steps.text: Select 'By Entity' from the Sync mode drop-down list to match endpoints of each entity

sequences.name: Set up parameters for 4-axis toolpaths
sequences.description: Select 'Wire/Power' and click the Tech button to change power settings for this toolpath.

steps.text: Select 'Wire/Power' and click the Tech button to change power settings for this toolpath
